original_rule_detail.admitted: a target is ADMITTED in a cell if at least 1 of its tries_per_cell tries succeeds (same wording as the shelf exclusions: 0 of N tries = not admitted)
original_rule_detail.a: height h meets (a) if foam brick (21) and tuna can (6) are both admitted in M16-L and in M16-R at h
original_rule_detail.best_support: BEST SUPPORT of family F (S8 over the 5 heights; IND28 over the 5 heights x 3 widths) = (identities) the set B_F of targets admitted in at least one cell of F's grid, and (rates) for each target t in B_F its largest success count over F's grid, k*_F(t)
original_rule_detail.b: height h meets (b) if S8 retains its best support at h AND IND28 retains its best support at h for at least one width W. F retains its best support at h (width W) if for EVERY target t in B_F: t is admitted at h (W) and its success count k there is not significantly lower than k*_F(t): one-sided Fisher exact test of k/N vs k*_F(t)/N, p >= alpha (sim/feasibility.py fisher_one_sided_lower). Equal identities with a significantly lower rate fail
original_rule_detail.choice: H_T = the smallest scanned height meeting (a) and (b); all five heights are scanned whatever the outcome
original_rule_detail.ind28_width: the IND28 width at H_T = the narrowest width W meeting (b) at H_T; W > 0.28 m is recorded as a tabletop variant with its exact dimensions (W x H_T x 0.005 m)
original_rule_detail.none: if no height meets (a) and (b) the outcome is reported as 'no height satisfies' and no height is picked
original_rule_detail.ycb_box: a ycb_box choice is kept if it admits at least one of the five targets; the class matrix then decides the ycb_box target list
original_rule_detail.implementation: sim/feasibility.py decide_height (unit-tested on synthetic results in tests/test_sim_arrange_tabletop.py before the run)

scope: Post-hoc review of development geometry, no policy result or test scene inspected. Per-seed success lists checked; no inferential p-values used for the recommendation.
smoke_disclosure: Before this plan was written the generator code was smoke-tested on dev seeds 9900-9911 and 9950-9961 (not used here) at a board height of 0.20 m (and 0.15 / 0.25 m in a 2-try pipeline check) for timing and for the parking rule: with the parked occluder's base centre required in frame at all 5 stops, 5 of 12 S8 parks succeeded (3 stops: 8 of 12; 1 stop: 12 of 12), so the base config requires >= 1 stop (on the seen table). No smoke result is used by the decision.

recommendation.status: Recommendation only; preserve original no-height outcome and record post-hoc development revision. Validate fixed choice with preplanned fresh class-matrix seeds.

design_check.limitations: Analytic convex-hull pinhole check only; exact rendered masks and pixels are not computed. Sampled corners are not a proof of a bound across the continuous pose range. Preserve fixed revisit draws and report actual rendered labels.

statistics_caveat: The committed Fisher comparisons treat shared-seed outcomes as independent and test each cell against a sample-selected best. Failure to reject lower success does not establish equivalence. Recommendations use recorded geometry and descriptive per-seed results, not this inferential gate.
fresh_check: Use the already planned independent dev probe seeds 7200-7299 for the selected configuration class matrix; do not change target slots during retries.
